newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark in Austrian tele-consortium.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark in Austrian tele-consortium.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark said on Friday that the Connect Austria consortium in which it participates won a 20-year, $180 million nationwide DCS 1800 mobile telephony contract in Austria.

The Connect Austria tele-consortium comprises Tele Danmark, with a 15 percent share, Norway's Telenor and Britain's Orange both with 17.45 percent, German VIAG with 20 percent, Austrian Heraklith Radex with 20.1 percent and Austrian Constantia Bank, with 10 percent.
In a statement, Tele Danmark said that Austria had two analogue mobile telephony networks (NMT 450 and TACS 900), two GSM systems and two paging systems.
PTA, the Austrian state telecommunications company holds the sole infrastructure and fixed telephony rights in the country.
It said that there were an estimated 730,000 mobile telephone subscribers at present in Austria, equal to nine percent of the population.
